backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the e-commerce backend, defining types and state for products, orders, users, site settings, and WhatsApp/Stripe configuration, with mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report identifying that the Razorpay checkout hook needs to be updated to include UPI as a payment method on both mobile and desktop devices.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and recent changes, serving as a build-planning reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow app, loading Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Lato), the Razorpay checkout script, and the React app via Vite.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with all customer routes (home, shop, product detail, cart, orders, payment) and protected admin routes (dashboard, products, orders, settings, users).
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: Section component displaying Ayurvedic philosophy content with scroll-triggered slide-in animations for left and right columns, including the three doshas and a link to the shop.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Route guard component that verifies the authenticated user has admin privileges via the canister actor before rendering children, showing loading, denied, error, or timeout states otherwise.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile overlay) containing navigation links, branding, and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI widget that simulates AI image generation by mapping a text prompt to a curated Unsplash botanical image, with a preview and a button to apply the selected image URL.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Modal dialog for viewing full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and updating the fulfillment status via a dropdown with optimistic UI and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: Modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, status, specifications, image upload, and AI image generation.
frontend/src/components/admin/StatusBadg: Renders a styled badge for a given ProductStatus enum value, mapping each status to a label and color class.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: Read-only modal dialog that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: Component file for an Ayurvedic hero animation (content truncated, purpose inferred from filename).
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Renders a section showcasing six product benefits (e.g., 100% Natural, Chemical-Free) as animated cards with icons, using IntersectionObserver for scroll-triggered fade-in animations.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer using a Sheet component that displays cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button that navigates to the /cart page.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured products fetched via a custom hook, with loading skeletons and a 'View All Products' link, filtering out non-visible products.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with pulse animation and tooltip that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat, using a backend-configured number with a fallback.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details, styled with a forest/cream color scheme.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a Ken Burns background image, animated brand name, tagline, and CTA buttons, using mount-state transitions for entrance animations.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer component that renders nav links (Home, Shop, Orders) and an auth button (Login/Logout), visible only on small screens.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop nav links, cart icon with item count badge, mobile hamburger menu triggering MobileNavDrawer, and logout/login actions using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product card with image, status badges, add-to-cart, and buy-now (Razorpay checkout) functionality; hides notVisible products and handles purchase flow with order creation.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that seeds the backend with sample products on mount if no products exist yet.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Renders an animated grid of customer testimonial cards with star ratings, quotes, product tags, and intersection-observer-based fade-in animations.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: In-memory React context providing cart state (items, open/close) and actions (add, remove, update quantity, clear) backed by Product objects with bigint IDs.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: React context for cart state that persists items to sessionStorage, supporting add, remove, update quantity, and clear operations with a cart-open toggle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including products, orders, user profiles, site settings, and Stripe/Razorpay configuration, wrapping actor calls with caching and mutation invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Provides a hook to open a Razorpay payment checkout with device-aware payment method configuration (mobile vs desktop), handling payment success by creating an order and navigating to a confirmation page.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for both a customer storefront (Ayurvedic/botanical theme) and an admin panel palette, including dark mode variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider.
Admin dashboard page displaying summary stats (revenue, orders, products, users) with bar and pie charts for revenue trends and fulfillment status, plus a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that handles Internet Identity authentication, checks or bootstraps admin status via the backend actor, and redirects to the admin products page on success.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page with sortable, searchable order cards that display customer details and allow updating fulfillment status via a dropdown.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin products page showing a searchable product catalog with status-based stats, and supports adding, editing, and deleting products via a modal form.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store name, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with live/test key validation and save actions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page that displays a searchable, filterable table of all registered users with a modal for user details. Uses `useGetAllUsers` hook and renders loading skeletons, empty states, and a clickable user list.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Cart page component that displays cart items with quantity controls, collects shipping/checkout form data, validates it, and processes payment via Razorpay before creating an order on success.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details via a form and initiates a Stripe payment session using cart items, redirecting the user to the Stripe-hosted checkout URL on success.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes the landing experience with a hero section, seed/featured products, benefits, testimonials, and an About Ayurveda section.
frontend/src/pages/Orders.tsx: Orders page that fetches and displays the authenticated user's order history with order cards showing product details, payment status badges, and fulfillment status badges.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static payment failure page shown after an unsuccessful payment, offering buttons to retry via the cart or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that invalidates the orders query cache on mount and presents navigation options to view orders or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that displays a single product's info with quantity selection, add-to-cart, and buy-now (Razorpay) functionality, handling loading and unavailable states.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop page that lists all visible products with search, category, and status filters applied client-side using memoized filtering logic.
frontend/src/utils/deviceDetection.ts: Exports `isMobileDevice()` which detects mobile/tablet devices using user-agent pattern matching and a screen width threshold of 768px.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides `formatINR` for Indian Rupee currency formatting and `formatDate` for converting nanosecond Motoko timestamps to human-readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Exports a `sampleProducts` array of five `ProductInput` objects representing Ayurvedic skincare products used to seed the product catalog.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom Ayurvedic brand color palette, admin-specific CSS variable tokens, custom fonts, shadows, and keyframe animations including Ken Burns effect.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for the Nature Glow app, recording that the active fix request is to include UPI as a visible payment option in the Razorpay desktop checkout flow.
